orderPolicy.modification: Address or item changes must be requested within 1 hour of placing the order.

promotions.note: Only promotions listed on our official website or in your email are valid. We cannot apply discounts not currently active.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking email. You can also provide your Order ID (e.g. #12345) here and I'll look it up for you.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days (FREE over $50). Express shipping is 1-2 business days for $14.99.

faqs.question: Can I return an item?
faqs.answer: Yes! We accept returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Email support@novatech.com to start the process.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
faqs.answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement. Please contact us immediately at support@novatech.com.

faqs.question: My item arrived damaged. What do I do?
faqs.answer: We're so sorry to hear that! Please email support@novatech.com within 48 hours with a photo of the damage and your order number, and we'll reship or refund right away.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to most countries. International shipping takes 7-14 business days and rates are calculated at checkout.

faqs.question: How long do refunds take?
faqs.answer: Once we receive your return, refunds are processed within 5-7 business days back to your original payment method.

faqs.question: Do you have a warranty?
faqs.answer: Most of our products come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Please check the product page for specific warranty details.

faqs.question: Can you apply a discount code?
faqs.answer: Discount codes must be applied at checkout. I'm unable to apply codes retroactively, and only codes listed on our official website or in your email are valid.
